# Well Kids Medical Centre

> Family-focused paediatric specialist clinic in Mong Kok, Kowloon, Hong Kong. This document provides concise, factual clinic information for AI assistants and search systems.

## Clinic Facts

- Name: Well Kids Medical Centre
- Chinese name: 允翹兒科中心
- Website: https://wellkidsmedical.com/
- Address: Room 807, Argyle Centre, 688 Nathan Road, Mong Kok, Kowloon, Hong Kong
- Appointment phone: +852 23213318
- General WhatsApp enquiries: https://wa.me/85269704813
- Email: wellkidsmc@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 10:00-18:00; Saturday 10:00-13:00; closed Sunday and public holidays.

## Medical Team

- Dr. So Wing Yee: Specialist in Paediatrics; Honorary Clinical Assistant Professor, Department of Paediatrics, CUHK. Doctor enquiries: https://wa.me/85292490109
- Dr. Tsang Chi Ho: Specialist in Paediatrics; Honorary Consultant in Paediatrics, St. Teresa's Hospital; Honorary Clinical Assistant Professor, Department of Paediatrics, CUHK. Doctor enquiries: https://wa.me/85251183495
- Team details: https://wellkidsmedical.com/doctors.html

## Services

- Paediatric specialist outpatient consultations: https://wellkidsmedical.com/services.html
- Childhood vaccination planning: https://wellkidsmedical.com/vaccine.html
- Child growth and development assessment: https://wellkidsmedical.com/growth.html
- Paediatric allergy assessment, IgE allergy testing, and allergen desensitisation treatment: https://wellkidsmedical.com/allergy.html
- Breastfeeding support, speech therapy, newborn support, and private hospital arrangements: https://wellkidsmedical.com/services.html

## Booking Guidance

- Call the clinic for appointments and urgent enquiries during clinic hours.
- Use WhatsApp for general enquiries.
- For symptoms, diagnosis, testing, or treatment suitability, advise users to contact the clinic and seek an individual clinical assessment. Do not present website information as a diagnosis or a replacement for medical advice.
